notes.title: END OF LIFE OF TOF
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Players and Supporters,[/p][p]Due to a sustained lack of interest in the indie game [i]Tactical Operations Force (TOF)[/i], we have made the difficult decision to shut down the game’s servers. Maintaining the servers entails ongoing monthly expenses, and unfortunately, the game has not generated sufficient revenue or received any donations to justify these costs.[/p][p]Although [i]TOF[/i] initially generated approximately $150 USD in sales, refund requests reduced the final revenue to less than $80 USD. The total development investment amounted to roughly $3,800 USD, making the project a commercial loss.[/p][p]We deeply regret having to make this decision and thank all those who supported the game during its development and release. Looking ahead, we hope to begin development on [i]Tactical Operations Force 2[/i] in the near future, contingent on the level of interest and support it receives.[/p][p]Thank you for your understanding.[/p][p]Sincerely,
[b]Leonardo Villegas[/b]
CEO, Tactical Operations Force[/p]
